def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=0]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and g[0][c]!=0]
    def bnds(sep,n):
        bs=[]; s=0
        for e in sep+[n]:
            if e-s>1: bs.append((s,e-1)); s=e+1
        return bs
    rb=bnds(sr,H); cb=bnds(sc,W)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (r0,r1) in rb:
        for k in range(len(cb)-1):
            (c0,c1),(c2,c3)=cb[k],cb[k+1]
            A=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
            B=[[out[r][c] for c in range(c2,c3+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
            nA=any(x!=0 for row_ in A for x in row_); nB=any(x!=0 for row_ in B for x in row_)
            if nA and not nB:
                for rr in range(len(A)):
                    out[r0+rr][c2:c3+1]=A[rr][::-1]
    return out
